<subject>Re: May 3 Testimony Preparation GIR/NGS</subject>
<body>
Thanks Thomas.  We shall make the additions you noted below.  Samrudh Commodities (Oliver Chatura) will be providing testimony on contract standardisation for the trading platforms. I agree with you that the independent trader associations should also include complementary testimony.  Although we discussed this earlier, I did not receive any firm commitments from the trader representatives that they would sponsor such testimony - it may be an oversight on my part.  Nonetheless, testimony by independent market participants should include a discussion of the benefits from Haryana Agro Exchange, Punjab Grain Board, NCDEX, Rajasthan Commodity Traders and the others.  Might I suggest that Agriculture India Pvt. Ltd., as a large commodity aggregator itself, coordinate this effort with the other trading partners?

In addition, I want all settlement parties to look beyond testimony to the hearings, which are scheduled to begin in little more than a month.  We will need to make some time available during late May for practice panels (assuming we are granted panel hearings) and individual practice cross-examination.  At the same time, we also need to start thinking about direct cross-examination of the ICRA/IAMAI parties (again, assuming we decide to engage in full cross-examination of their settlement).  There is merit to cross-examination of the opposing settlement since it is not very well thought out, results in substantial cost-shifts, and is not consistent with the NCDEX's most promising options.  On the other hand, there is merit to limiting our cross, especially of Pranit, who will use the witness box to grandstand.  It's something to think about.
</body>

Thanks for your memo.  Let me add the following comments.  There should be a chapter on the trader settlement with the key parties listed.  Rachit Dave and Tanish should be added to the chapter on impact on commodity processors.  The Procurement section where you list Cargill and Bunge was, I believe, originally supposed to include program benefits for the core aggregators as well, and you should add Agriculture India Pvt.
